## Checklist

- [ ] Commits include DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Tests cover the change and pass locally (`make test`, `make lint`).
- [ ] Documentation, JSON schemas and changelog are updated when needed.
- [ ] New diagnostics have an `SCD-` code and `make docs` was run.
- [ ] Claims about external behavior (CA/B Forum, CAs, cert-manager, cloud APIs) cite a public source or are marked `VERIFY:`.
